subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt #101863 as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, and which track is approved first?
rationale: Source evidence supports the problem class and VISION.md supports stability work, but the issue chooses lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, restart persistence, and completion semantics across stable gateway surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and split Track A-D into focused implementation issues or PRs with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve Track A first
options.body: Start with abort-to-release and stale-running takeover while deferring durability, Codex liveness, and completion-drive decisions.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella as canonical and continue landing narrow fixes against the existing production reports.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the owner-approved direction and split Track A-D into focused implementation issues or PRs with source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored and self-assigned the umbrella and recently touched the central stalled-lane recovery surface.
